stage.name: lc-qa-windows-retest
stage.method: sha256 of the sorted sha256sum lines over package.json + dist/**; rebuild = git archive 86d2405 (package.json tsconfig.json apps packages) + tsc -p apps/windows/tsconfig.json + copy-static.mjs

backend_copy.after_the_run: 19 __pycache__ folders written by the host (as in the c4c84a5 pass)

owner_module_tests_on_this_tree.command: LC_BACKEND_ROOT=<git archive 86d2405> LC_PYTHON=<repo venv python> node --test --test-timeout=30000 tests/*.test.ts (apps/windows)
owner_module_tests_on_this_tree.note: the owner's own tests with an in-memory store; a control, not native QA. Without the two variables 44 are skipped (190 pass)

harness: run.json harness_sha256 holds the executed files; they are committed unchanged (checked after the run)

display.note: the two display checks and the Edge/console check are QA process listings made outside the runner; only these times are recorded
